question: Sapna invested ₹20,300 on simple interest, partly at the rate of 5% per annum and partly at the rate of 9% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 7 years, then find the sum invested at the rate of 5% per annum (in ₹).
solution:
**Given:**

Total investment = ₹20,300

Rate₁ = 5%

Rate₂ = 9%

Time = 7 years

Interests from both parts are equal

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Equal interest ⇒ SI₁ = SI₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let P₁ = x (sum at 5%) and P₂ = 20300 − x

⇒ (x × 5 × 7) ÷ 100 = ((20300 − x) × 9 × 7) ÷ 100

⇒ Cancel 7 and ÷100: 5x = 9(20300 − x)

⇒ 5x = 9 × 20300 − 9x

⇒ 5x = 182700 − 9x

⇒ 5x + 9x = 182700

⇒ 14x = 182700

⇒ x = 182700 ÷ 14

⇒ x = 13050

**∴ The correct answer is 13050.**
